Stop comment: 'I represent a stop of a means of transport. I know my name and my distance to the head of the line, and with that I can tell the distance to any other stop of my line, which is the absolute difference between both distances to the head of the line.
I am always unique, even if another means of transport has a stop with my same name.'.

FareTable comment: 'I am the fare table (cuadro tarifario) of a means of transport. I know the price charged for each bracket of distance, expressed as the maximum distance of the bracket and the price of that bracket, and I answer the price for any distance.
A means of transport with a fixed price, like a subway line, has a fare table with a single bracket that reaches PlusInfinity.'.

TransportLine comment: 'I represent a means of transport, be it a bus line, a subway line or a train branch. I know my route, as an ordered collection of stops going from the head of the line to the end of the route, and my fare table, and I can answer the price of travelling between two of my stops.
I am the same class for every means of transport because what changes between them is not the route nor the way the price is calculated, but the way the card is charged, and that is the responsibility of my card readers. Charging a fixed price, like the subway does, is just a matter of having a fare table with a single bracket.'.

CardReader comment: 'I am the card reader of a means of transport. When a BAJE card is brought close to me I charge the trip being made to it, after checking that both the origin and the destination are stops of my means of transport and that they are different.
My subclasses define the way in which the trip being made is informed to me.'.

BusCardReader comment: 'I am the card reader of a bus. The origin and the destination of the trip are informed to me when the card is tapped, and the price charged depends on the distance between them.'.

TurnstileCardReader comment: 'I am the card reader of a turnstile, used by the means of transport in which the trip is paid when entering a stop informing the direction in which the passenger is going. That direction has to be either the head of the line or the end of the route, and it is taken as the destination of the trip.'.

SubwayCardReader comment: 'I am the card reader of a turnstile of a subway stop. The whole trip is paid when entering, and as the fare table of a subway line is flat, the price does not depend on the stop nor on the direction.'.

TrainCardReader comment: 'I am the card reader of a turnstile of a train stop. When entering, the trip up to the direction the passenger is going is charged. Marking the exit is optional; when it is marked, the price of the trip actually made is calculated and the difference with what was charged when entering is refunded, keeping the discount that was applied at that moment. If the exit is not marked, what was charged when entering is kept.'.

BajeCard comment: 'I am a BAJE card. I know my balance, the trips that were paid with me and the discount I was configured with. There always has to be enough balance to pay for a trip.
I am the one who knows how to apply the discounts, because they depend on the trips already made with me: I ask my discount for the rate to apply to the full price of the trip, and I answer it the transfer rate when its own discount does not apply, as discounts are not cumulative.'.

Trip comment: 'I represent a trip made with a BAJE card. I know where it started, where it ended, when it started, the full price of the trip, the discount rate that was applied to it and the price actually charged.
I keep the discount rate because the price of a train trip is adjusted when the exit is marked, and that adjustment has to keep the discount that was applied when the trip started.'.

Discount comment: 'I am the discount configuration of a BAJE card. I answer the rate that has to be applied to the full price of a trip. My subclasses answer the rate of the card, which is the transfer rate when their own discount does not apply, as discounts are not cumulative.'.

NoDiscount comment: 'I am the configuration of a card that has no discount of its own, so it always pays the full price of the trip, or half of it when the trip is a transfer.'.

StudentDiscount comment: 'I am the configuration of a student card. From Monday to Friday it pays half of the price and no other discount is applied, as discounts are not cumulative. On weekends it pays the full price, so the transfer discount does apply.'.

RetireeDiscount comment: 'I am the configuration of a retiree card. The first two trips of each day are free and no other discount is applied to them, as discounts are not cumulative. The rest of the trips of the day pay the full price, so the transfer discount does apply to them.'.

ISWMetropolitanoTest comment: 'I hold the fixture used by all the tests of the ISWMetropolitano system: the bus line 60, the subway line D and the Retiro-Tigre branch of the Mitre train, with the dates of a weekend and of some week days of November of 2025.'.
